ONTOS es un modelo digital de todo lo tu: A digital model of everything that's yours (finances, documents, admin, health) that an AI keeps up to date and answers when you ask. All on your machine.
Un modelo ordenado de todo lo tuyo y una: An ordered model of everything that's yours, and an AI that keeps it up to date. All local: your data never leaves your computer.

Finanzas, documentos, trámites, proyecto: Finances, documents, admin, projects, diary, health: all in one place, on your machine, and available just by asking. I built it for myself and I use it every day.
En piloto privado. Todo funciona en loca: In private pilot. Everything runs locally: your data never leaves your computer.
ONTOS es un <strong>gemelo digital</stro: ONTOS is a digital twin: an ordered model of what you have, what you do and what you know, with artificial intelligence working on top of it every day.
Cada hecho vive una vez. Las vistas, los: Every fact lives once. Views, reports and summaries are generated from it, so nothing contradicts itself or goes stale in a forgotten copy.
Le cuentas en una frase lo que ha pasado: You tell it in one sentence what has happened and it updates everything that is affected. You ask in plain language and it answers with your own data, citing where each thing comes from.
Un sistema sin vigilancia se degrada. Un: A system nobody watches degrades. An automatic check runs every day to make sure nothing is lost, that the views match their source and that no loose end is left hanging.
Todo se ejecuta en tu máquina. Sin nube: Everything runs on your machine. No compulsory cloud, no account to create, none of your data feeding anybody's product.
Tu vida entera en un solo modelo, y la p: Your whole life in a single model, and the boring part done for you.

<strong>ONTOS no es una promesa: es lo q: ONTOS is not a promise: it is what I use every day since June 2026. What you see in the cases is running on my own instance, with my real data.
Está <strong>en piloto privado</strong>,: It is in private pilot, and I open it up one person at a time: I sit down with each of them on day one, we build their model and we switch on only the modules that are useful to them. You learn and you fix before taking the next step.
There is no public price yet. I would rather learn with the first few people before putting a figure on it, and tell you so straight instead of selling you a list of features.
